etsy.title: Valentine Kindness Countdown for Kids, Kindness Cupid Letter and 14 Kindness Notes, Candy Free Classroom Valentine Cards, Printable
etsy.description:
Hearts instead of candy. 💗

The Valentine Kindness Cupid brings one kind mission a day for the 14 days before Valentine's Day. Each morning your child finds a note from a little cupid: tell someone why you love them, play with someone who is alone, make a card for your teacher. Read it together, do it together, color one heart. Five minutes a day, no mess.

WHAT'S INSIDE (18 pages)
• Cupid arrival letter
• Cupid passport (name it, draw it)
• 14 kindness notes, 4 per page (Feb 1–14)
• Heart kindness tracker
• 2 lifesaver letters: "My wings got tangled" and "I was busy making cards"
• Halfway letter
• 12 candy-free Valentine kindness cards for classmates (print 3x for a class)
• Valentine's Day goodbye letter + "I Was Kind!" certificate
• 8 blank notes + 30 more tiny kindness ideas

AGES: 3 to 8. Great for families and preschool or kindergarten classrooms.

PAIR IT WITH: Kindness Snowman Kit for January, in our shop.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
